hypothesis: Privileged historical TrackMan labels can supervise an out-of-time auxiliary representation of current pitch selection and physics. Feeding only those pre-pitch predictions and their frozen-profile deviations to component C may capture count- and matchup-dependent repertoire changes that completed-season averages and teacher-probability distillation missed.

novelty_audit.failure_component_multitask: Previously tested, but its auxiliary labels were official failure components rather than TrackMan physics.
novelty_audit.teacher_probability_distillation: Previously tested and failed; it compressed physics into a control probability or completed-season teacher profile.
novelty_audit.conditional_trackman_profiles: Previously tested as fixed count/platoon aggregates, not as supervised current-pitch imputation from the full legal row.
novelty_audit.this_candidate: Cross-season pitch-group classification plus multi-output physics regression, with no current-pitch TrackMan at deployment.

data_contract.source_cutoff: For a query row in season S, auxiliary models fit only official matched R rows with season < S.

auxiliary_recipe.inputs: the 47 official BASE_FEATURES from the same query row
auxiliary_recipe.physics_model: CatBoostRegressor MultiRMSE after per-source standardization, predictions restored to physical units
auxiliary_recipe.generated_features: 4 group probabilities, probability entropy, 8 predicted physics values, availability, 8 physics-minus-rich-profile deviations, and 4 group-probability-minus-rich-profile deviations
auxiliary_recipe.history_rows_without_prior_trackman_seas: all auxiliary values missing and availability=0
auxiliary_recipe.non_R_query_rows: all auxiliary values missing and availability=0

execution_order.continue_to_2023_only_if: 2022 R point gain and pitcher-cluster 95% CI lower are positive versus exact C and both honest R anchors
execution_order.read_2024_only_if: the unchanged recipe passes every 2022 and 2023 requirement
